event.title: SFSCON '26 - "When hardware breaks free" in Bolzano, Italy in Bolzano, Italy

body.p: Open Source Hardware (OSH) is not only an important element of digital commons, as it has become a key enabler of permissionless innovation. Understanding licensing issues is important, however, to explore the maximal potential of OSH.

In this talk, Lucas Lasota will aim clarifying the main elements of OSH licenses, and it aims professionals and hobbyists working and developing OSH. No previous knowledge on legal topics or OSH is required.
The talk will be in English and it will take place in the Seminar 3.
